about_the_game:
Unveil the dark beauty behind the madness.
The Worshippers of Cthulhu: Artbook is a 138-page digital collection showcasing the haunting world of the Cult of Cthulhu. This DLC offers an exclusive glimpse into the artistic vision behind the game - from the twisted architecture of cult cities to the otherworldly creatures, eldritch rituals, and the followers who serve the Great Old Ones.

Crafted with atmosphere and storytelling in mind, the artbook blends concept designs, environmental details, and select ritual scenes that bring the Lovecraftian horror to life. Whether you’re a fan of dark fantasy, cosmic horror, or simply want a deeper connection to the visual lore of the game, this artbook is a must-have addition.

content_descriptors.notes: Worshippers of Cthulhu: Artbook contains stylized horror artwork inspired by Lovecraftian themes, including scenes of blood, ritual sacrifice, and occasional partial nudity. While these elements are minimal and artistic in nature, the content may not be suitable for all audiences due to suggestive imagery and depictions of violence.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 18.04+, Fedora 30+, or equivalent
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 2.5GHz, AMD FX-Series
  • Memory: 512 MB MB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics, Nvidia GTX 660, AMD Radeon HD 7870
  • Storage: 100 MB available space
  • Sound Card: N/A
  • Additional Notes: Any modern Linux distro with a PDF viewer like Evince or Okular will work fine

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 10.13+
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 (2.5GHz+), Apple M1
  • Memory: 512 MB MB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 4000, Apple M1 GPU
  • Storage: 100 MB MB available space
  • Sound Card: N/A
  • Additional Notes: Pretty much any Mac from the last decade can display PDFs
